description.narrative: Stöd till RCO Jemen 2023-2024 Insatsen syftar till att stärka utvecklingskoordinering, liksom koordinering mellan utvecklings- och humanitära aktörer. Syftet är även att främja planering kring hållbara lösningar för internt fördrivna. Stöd utgår för en kriskoordinator.

Support to RCO Yemen 2023-2024 The contribution aims to strengthen development coordination, as well as coordination between development and humanitarian actors. The objective is also to promote durable solutions for internally displaced. Support is also provided for a crisis coordinator.

The objective of the support is to enable the Resident Coordinator (RC) of the United Nations deliver strengthened and strategic coordination across the humanitariand-evelopment- peace nexus in Yemen through support to the Yemen Partner Group and its technical architecture, and to enable implementation of the Economic Framework as a nexus approach for Yemen.
Concretely, the implementation of activities and achievement of outputs aims to bring the donor community in Amman and Riyadh closer to development and Humanitarian/ development/peace nexus (HDPN) activities on the ground in Yemen, both Sana'a and Aden, addressing a gap in coordination, information-sharing and strategic decision-making. The initiatives are also designed to support alignment of financing priorities of the international community.
On June 26, 2024, a decision was taken to provide additional funding for a crisis coordinator, that supports the RC for a period of 6 months.

1. Strengthened coordination • Conducted eight YPG and fourteen YPTT meetings, fostering strategic alignment and policy development. • Facilitated ongoing stakeholder engagement and donor liaison. • Established the Yemen data repository to enhance data coherence efforts. 2. Implementation of economic framework •Organized consultation sessions, delivered Governorate level assessments, and conducted political economy analyses. •Supported the creation of an Area-based approach for humanitarian-development programming in the city of Taiz. •Initiated gender sensitive pilot projects under Pillar 2. •Provided regular progress reports on Economic Framework implementation. 3. Crisis response aid worker detention •Drafted and implemented an engagement strategy to address the detention of aid workers. •Chaired a dedicated working group of UN agencies and INGOs on the issue. •Supported coordination between UN leadership and external stakeholders. •Strengthened interagency coordination and strategic crisis response mechanisms.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
